title: Fastest Ascent of All 14 Eight-Thousanders
details: Shattered all historical records by scaling all 14 peaks above 8,000m across Nepal, Pakistan, and Tibet in under three months.

title: First to Summit All 14 Without Bottled O2
details: Completed the entire 14x8000m crown in pure alpine and lightweight styles without supplemental oxygen tanks.

title: First Winter Ascent of K2
holder: 10-Climber All-Nepali Team (Led by Nirmal Purja & Mingma G)
details: Conquered Earth's most dangerous mountain in winter at -60°C and hurricane winds, halting 10 meters below the summit to step on top together as a team.

title: Most Summits of Mount Everest
details: Known as the 'Everest Man', guiding international teams safely for over three decades across the Khumbu Icefall and Southeast Ridge.

title: Youngest Climber on All 14 Eight-Thousanders
details: Completed all 14 summits at age 18, representing the next generation of visionary Himalayan high-altitude athletes.

title: National Hero of the Karakoram: Ali Sadpara
details: First human to summit Nanga Parbat in winter (alongside Alex Txikon & Simone Moro); celebrated globally for humbleness, super-human strength, and proud representation of Gilgit-Baltistan.
